About.Name: Mason Harris
About.AboutText:
Hi, I am Mason Harris. I am a Computer Science student at Seattle Pacific University with a strong passion for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and building performant software. I enjoy taking on ambitious projects, from developing AI-powered SaaS applications to diving deep into C++ for performance-based solutions.

I am heavily involved in entrepreneurial tech, having co-founded a solar data platform and independently developed Flowposal, an AI-powered proposal automation tool. I am constantly learning and expanding my skill set, driven by a desire to create impactful and innovative software.

Experience.ExperienceText: I am a driven software developer and entrepreneur with experience building full-stack applications and AI-powered data pipelines. I am currently pursuing my BS in Computer Science while actively developing real-world SaaS products.
Experience.EducationText: Relevant Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms, Software Engineering, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Database Systems, Differential Equations.
Experience.EmploymentText: Co-founded a data startup; specialized in building an AI-powered data extraction pipeline using Python, Selenium, and an Ollama model that ingested and processed over 500,000 building permit records.
Experience.SkillsText: Expert-level prompt engineering with AI code generation tools, full-stack development, and data pipeline orchestration.

Project1.Title: flowposal
Project1.Desc: An AI-Powered SaaS for Upwork Freelancers. Architected the entire full-stack system using Next.js, React, Supabase, and the Google Gemini API to automate proposal generation and resume analysis.

Project2.Title: HuntOrca Data Pipeline
Project2.Desc: Developed a robust web scraping pipeline for California solar data. Engineered an 'intelligent scraper' by fine-tuning a local Ollama model to perform entity extraction on unstructured HTML.
